explanation: Compared against WOWII Conjecture 40 (status O): for connected G on more than one vertex, f(G) ≥ ⌈(p(G) + b(G) + 1)/2⌉, with f the largest induced forest, p the path covering number (minimum number of vertex-disjoint paths covering V, WOWII def 12) and b the largest induced bipartite subgraph. pathCoverNumber uses disjoint covering paths, matching def 12. The statement matches with the real ceiling. Faithful.
